New East-West Rail Corridor Announced to Connect Unserved Areas

Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has announced the development of a new East-West Rail Corridor. This project aims to connect unserved regions, particularly in Maharashtra. The initiative is expected to provide new rail links to previously unconnected areas within the state.
